response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT mix, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), r AS (SELECT mix, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT mix, cnt AS analysis_count, share, share - avg_share AS excess_over_avg_share FROM r WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Only advanced behaviour analyses that match a transaction record are counted (inner join). The overall total is the count of those matched rows.
The plain average share is the unweighted mean of the per-mix shares, with NULL ordertypedist counted as one mix. This equals 1 divided by the number of mixes.
Values are left unrounded, and ties with the average are excluded because the filter is strictly greater than.
